title: Chapter 39
text:
Black Spider? After all, this was a mini boss level character.

Logically speaking, such a mission should be rated D, and the reward should be at least 30,000 experience points.

Galaxy's mission mechanics were very detailed. Even if a team of players accepted the same mission, the mission requirements would be slightly different, and different rewards would be given according to the player's level and position.

Some business players did not like to fight monsters and focused on manufacturing and logistics. When they joined a team to accept a mission, the difficulty and rewards would be reduced. For example, when it came to fighting monsters, the combat players who charged at the front and had the most responsibilities would have the highest rewards, followed by healers and support players. Logistics players who followed the team to gain experience would have the lowest rewards, which reduced the situation of rich players paying for a team to farm experience.

Han Xiao hated this system in his previous life, and it caused his farming business to be very quiet. Instead, his most popular business was helping people to seek revenge, and he had trained himself to the peak of PK.

Han Xiao was in such a situation. The reason the reward was reduced was obviously because he was the backup in this mission, so he did not have to fight Black Spider himself. The reward was directly linked to the difficulty of the mission.

Sigh, although it's a little less, at least it's better than no experience.

Han Xiao could only comfort himself with this. At least he had another source of experience points.

According to his understanding of Black Spider, this mission was a free 5,000 experience points. Li Ya Lin's secret service team could defeat Black Spider with their eyes closed. What he cared about was the special reward.

There was no need to think too much about it. He knew exactly what the hidden request was. Just as Lin Yao had said, he had to capture Black Spider.

Black Spider's ability was very difficult to deal with. Capturing him was ten times more difficult than defeating him. Until now, no one knew that Black Spider was an Esper. His ability was only revealed after the open beta. However, Han Xiao knew the weakness of Black Spider's ability very well.

The system was inanimate, and it would only judge the difference in strength based on the interface. The probability of him completing the hidden requirement was very low.

If the team listened to his command, he was eighty percent sure that he could capture Black Spider.

I think it's worth a try, Han Xiao thought.

Li Ya Lin was still thinking about the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. She asked, "How much does it cost to order? How long will it take to get the goods?"

"A Lightweight Mechanical Arm costs 20,000 RMB, 10,000 RMB in advance. You provide the materials, and I'll build it for you. You'll get the goods in two days."

Li Ya Lin's face turned bitter. It was almost as much as her monthly salary, but she still decided to buy it. She was going to act at night, and there wasn't enough time. She didn't give up and asked, "Do you have any other machines?

Han Xiao thought for a moment. He didn't want to expose the high-explosive bullets for the time being, so he took out the retractable machete. The black metal handle of the machete attracted the three's attention.

"What's the use of this?" Li Ya Lin was confused.

Han Xiao smiled and pressed the micro-mechanism on the hilt with his finger. With a sudden swing, sections of the blade were thrown out of the hilt. Immediately, it turned into a nearly 70cm long black alloy blade, which was very sharp.

"This thing is called the Retractable Saber."

Li Ya Lin's eyes lit up. She had chosen the staff as her weapon because of its portability, and the Retractable Battle Knife was even better. Not only was it more stealthy, it was also more powerful. She extended her hand towards the Retractable Battle Knife, but Han Xiao dodged.

"One thousand for one."

Han Xiao laughed. The cost of the Retractable Battle Knife was only about 300 yuan. He was kind enough not to offer 2,000 yuan.

"Cheapskate! You're such a money-grubber! " Li Ya Lin fumed. She took out her wallet and gave him 1,000 yuan. Han Xiao then passed the Retractable Battle Knife to her and explained in detail how to use it. Li Ya Lin immediately started playing with it.

Lambert suddenly said, "I want to order ten of them. Can they be reduced to about 30 centimeters?"

Business had come knocking! Han Xiao was overjoyed and nodded. "No problem."

"I hope to get them before the operation tonight."

"Sure, as long as the materials are in place."

The initial shape of the Retractable Battle Knife could be polished in batches using a press lathe.

Lin Yao hesitated. "I also want to buy one for self-defense."

Han Xiao was a little surprised. The Retractable Battle Knife was a novice weapon. Why was it so popular among agents?

What he didn't know was that the research and development department was always behind the scenes, so the agents of Division 13 were hungry for new equipment. Although the Retractable Battle Knife was simple, it was often only portable and covert equipment that could be used for complex missions.

The close-combat weapons of the special agents were generally daggers. Think about it, if you were to encounter the special agents of other forces, the enemy would pull out a dagger that was more than ten centimeters long, while you would pull out a saber that was almost one meter long. You would win in terms of momentum. It was the same principle as comparing the length of a man's knife in the toilet.

…

The materials were provided by Lambert and Lin Yao. Han Xiao borrowed the logistics department's private workshop. The equipment was very advanced, and it greatly reduced the manufacturing time of the Retractable Battle Knife. Before the operation at night, Han Xiao had already manufactured 11 custom-made Retractable Battle Knives in batches.

He received 11,000 Aquamarine Dollars. He only paid the cost of the technology, but he also gained a lot of experience points. He earned about 8,000 experience points. It was a small profit.

This made him even more certain that there was a huge potential market for the Retractable Battle Knife.

Li Ya Lin and the other two took the equipment and set off to hunt down Black Spider. Han Xiao stayed in the Covert Operations Department to take charge of logistics and organize the details of the mission sent by the intelligence department.

The pinhole cameras and mini earphones of the three teammates were connected to the three computer screens in front of Han Xiao. The images and sounds were synchronized, and Han Xiao could see what the three of them were going through. His responsibility was to monitor the situation at all times, and to give out hints and orders, which was equivalent to the role of a commander.

Of course, Han Xiao was a newbie. Although the three of them didn't say it out loud, they didn't completely trust his judgment. This mission was not difficult, and they only let Han Xiao be the commander to train the team. However, it was impossible for them to completely follow orders. The three of them were all experienced agents, and they had their own judgment. Han Xiao's instructions could at most be used as a reference.

Han Xiao was very calm. Not to mention his experience in leading a fifty-man team in a dungeon, his advantage in intelligence was enough for him to do this job.

Black Spider, an Esper, was very difficult to deal with. He was listed as the most difficult boss to kill in Blue Star Version 1.0.

…

At night, the stars shone brightly.

The slum was located in District 8. Unlike the bustling cities in other districts, this place was very dilapidated. The houses here did not have roofs, only canopies made of scrap metal and canvas. They were tightly packed together, causing the streets to be very narrow. All kinds of wet clothes with patches were hung on the balconies, and the streets were littered with trash. A large number of drug dealers, prostitutes, hooligans, and homeless people lived here. The security here was very poor, and the intelligence department said that Black Spider was hiding here.

Li Ya Lin and the other two were fully armed. Although Lin Yao was a hacker, he had also received firearms training and had a certain level of combat ability.
